build_pytorch_model: build a PyTorch regression model using PyTorchModelConfig with encoder and decoder vocabularies
convert_examples_to_tensors: convert core.Example objects into encoder and decoder input tensors via the model converter
compute_log_probabilities: compute log probabilities for a batch of example tensors using the model log_prob method
decode_model_samples: decode multiple samples from the model returning token IDs and output float values
fine_tune_model: fine-tune the PyTorch model using PyTorchFineTuner with optional LoRA and early stopping
